theorem: For A=U Lambda U^T+E using any three large eigenvectors, any original-coordinate partition I,J, residual cross SVD E[I,J]=L Sigma R^T of rank r, k=3+r, and augmented maps T_I=[U_I^T;Sigma^(1/2)L^T], T_J=[U_J^T;Sigma^(1/2)R^T], if G_I=T_I T_I^T and G_J=T_J T_J^T are positive definite then p_(X^TAX) is bounded continuous and ||p||_inf <= e*k/(k-2)*|det Lambda|^(-1/k)*(det G_I det G_J)^(-1/(2k)).
primary_mechanism: Unconditional original-product projection caps are taken before curvature; the residual cross phase is retained and becomes an exact full-rank L2 Fourier operator with cross matrix diag(Lambda,I_r).
